message.content: How do sessions work in this codebase?

content.text: I read src/sessions/store.ts, src/sessions/events.ts and src/transport/client.ts. store.ts keeps SessionStore, the in-memory map of live sessions keyed by session id. events.ts emits session-opened and session-closed events when the store changes. client.ts holds the session token for the connection and reconnects with it after a drop.
